question: Which Indian duo scripted history by becoming the first Indian men’s doubles pair to win the Singapore Open title in 2026?

options.text: Kim Won Ho and Seo Seung Jae

solution:
The correct answer is __**Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• On **May 31, 2026**, **Satwiksairaj Rankireddy** and **Chirag Shetty** won the **Singapore Open** men's doubles title, ending a two-year title drought.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• **Historical Achievement:** The pair became the **first Indian men's doubles team** to win the **Singapore Open** event.
• **The Final Match:** They defeated the **Indonesian** pair of **Fajar Alfian** and **Muhammad Fikri** with a score of **18-21, 21-17, 21-16** in a match that lasted **one hour and 13 minutes**.
• **Title Milestone:** This victory marked their **ninth career World Tour title** and their **third Super 750 crown**.
• **Ending the Drought:** Their last title before this win was at the **Thailand Open in 2024**; they had four runner-up finishes in the interim.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• **Rankings:** The Indian duo entered the competition as the **world No. 4** pair.
• **Tournament Highlights:** En route to the final, they secured a significant **semifinal victory** against the reigning world champions, **Kim Won Ho** and **Seo Seung Jae** of South Korea.
• **Past Successes:** **Satwiksairaj Rankireddy** and **Chirag Shetty** are also **Asian Games** and **Commonwealth Games** champions.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• **Comparison with Options:**
• **Srikanth Kidambi and Lakshya Sen:** These are prominent Indian singles players and did not win the men's doubles title in this tournament.
• **Fajar Alfian and Muhammad Fikri:** They were the **finalists from Indonesia** who were defeated by the Indian duo.
• **Kim Won Ho and Seo Seung Jae:** They are the world champions from **South Korea** who were defeated by Satwik-Chirag in the **semifinals**.</ul
